info.title: API.SH: MaxMilhas
info.description: The MaxMilhas API from API.SH: public MaxMilhas data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Airports and cities matching a name or code, as the MaxMilhas search box suggests them: IATA code, airport name, city and country. City entries (`is_city`) cover all of a city's airports (e.g. SAO for São Paulo). Use the codes as `origin`/`destination` in the flight search and price calendar.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/maxmilhas-airports

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Airport, city or code, 2-60 characters (e.g. recife, galeão, GRU).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

items.name: Aerop. Internacional de Guarulhos - Governador André Franco Montoro, São Paulo, Brasil

get.description:
The cheapest one-way fare MaxMilhas has seen for each departure day between two airports or cities over a date range (up to 62 days): date, departure time, the airports of that fare, price in BRL, fare type (miles or airline), the site's rating (cheap, average, expensive) and when the price was seen. Use it to find the cheapest day, then search that day with /maxmilhas/v1/flights. Days without a recent search are left out.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/maxmilhas-calendar

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Departure airport or city code (IATA).

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Arrival airport or city code (IATA).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today + `days_ahead`).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: start + `days` - 1).

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: First day as days from today (default 0), when `start` is not given.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days from the first day, 1-62 (default 30), when `end` is not given.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One-way or round-trip flights from MaxMilhas, the Brazilian travel site that sells tickets issued with airline miles next to regular airline fares. Searches GOL, LATAM, Azul and, for international routes, the other airlines the site works with, and returns every offer: fare type (`miles` for a ticket issued with miles, `airline` for the airline's own fare), total price in BRL with base fare, taxes, fees and Pix discounts, the price the airline itself charges and the saving, per-passenger prices, and the outbound and inbound flight options each offer covers (carrier, times, duration, stops, baggage, segments with flight numbers; times are local to each airport). `airlines` lists which airlines were searched and how many offers each returned. Results are the full set for the search (no paging). Search and filter by airline, fare type and stops; sort by price, duration or departure. A search takes 10-40 seconds.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/maxmilhas-flights

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Departure airport or city code (IATA), e.g. GRU, CGH or SAO (all São Paulo airports).

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Arrival airport or city code (IATA), e.g. REC, RIO or LIS.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Give this or `days_ahead`.

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: Departure date as days from today (Brazil time), 0-360; used when `date` is not given.

parameters.name: return_date
parameters.description: Return date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a round trip.

parameters.name: return_days
parameters.description: Round trip: return this many days after the departure date (instead of `return_date`).

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Adults, 1-9 (default 1).

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Children aged 2-11, 0-8 (default 0). Adults plus children at most 9.

parameters.name: infants
parameters.description: Infants under 2 on a lap, at most one per adult (default 0).

parameters.name: cabin
parameters.description: Cabin class (default economy).

parameters.name: max_stops
parameters.description: Only flight options with at most this many stops (0 = nonstop).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the offers: price (lowest total first, default), duration (shortest outbound option first) or departure (earliest outbound option first).

parameters.name: airlines
parameters.description: Only these airlines, comma separated, as listed in a response's `airlines` (e.g. gol,latam,azul).

parameters.name: fare_type
parameters.description: Only miles tickets (`miles`) or airline fares (`airline`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Hotels, inns (pousadas) and resorts for a destination and dates from MaxMilhas: name, type, stars, nightly and total price in BRL with taxes, Pix discount and the price before discount, meal plan, free cancellation, rooms left, installments and payment methods, address with neighborhood and coordinates, distance from the destination, Tripadvisor rating and review count, amenities and a photo. Filter by stars, meal plan, property type, amenity, free cancellation, nightly price and hotel name; `filters_available` lists every filter value with its count for the search, and `applied_filters` echoes what the site applied. The destination is matched to the site's own place suggestions; `destination_candidates` lists them and `place_id` picks another. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/maxmilhas-hotels

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: City, neighborhood, landmark or hotel name, resolved with the site's own place search (e.g. Recife, Copacabana, Gramado).

parameters.name: place_id
parameters.description: Pick one of the response's `destination_candidates` (the places the site suggests for `destination`) when the best match is not the place you meant.

parameters.name: checkin
parameters.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD. Give this or `days_ahead`.

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: Check-in as days from today (Brazil time), 0-360; used when `checkin` is not given.

parameters.name: checkout
parameters.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: check-in + `nights`).

parameters.name: nights
parameters.description: Nights when `checkout` is not given, 1-30 (default 1).

parameters.name: adults
parameters.description: Adults, 1-16 (default 2), spread over the rooms.

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Children's ages (0-17), comma separated, one per child, e.g. 8,5.

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description: Rooms, 1-8 (default 1).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), best_value, price_asc, price_desc or distance.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page, 1-based (default 1).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Hotels per page, 1-50 (default 20).

parameters.name: stars
parameters.description: Star ratings, comma separated, e.g. 4,5.

parameters.name: meal_plans
parameters.description: Meal plans, comma separated: BB (breakfast), RO (room only), HB (half board), FB (full board), AI (all inclusive).

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Property types as listed in `filters_available` (e.g. Hotel, Pousada, Resort), comma separated.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Amenities as listed in `filters_available` (e.g. Piscina), comma separated.

parameters.name: refundable
parameters.description: true: only rates with free cancellation.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest nightly price in whole BRL.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest nightly price in whole BRL.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Only hotels whose name contains this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
